purpose: Recover the omitted whole-body SVZ samples without inferring animal identity from gene expression or unused factor levels.

requested_artifacts.artifact: All RNA cell barcodes to animal assignments before publication sample filtering
requested_artifacts.acceptance: Unique library-plus-barcode join; included samples reproduce the deposited subsets; omitted groups remain explicitly identifiable. Preserve unassigned barcodes and rejected droplets.

requested_artifacts.artifact: Full per-cell LMO count matrices and feature/oligo maps
requested_artifacts.acceptance: Counts include excluded groups and precede publication filtering. A list of six or twelve feature names without the omitted cell columns does not meet this requirement.
requested_artifacts.raw_alternative: Exact deposited LMO or Undetermined FASTQ accessions with read structure and sample sheet, if the matrix is unavailable. Current SRA originals inventory lists GEX files only.

requested_artifacts.artifact: Full filtered Seurat RDS objects before excluding 2Dox5 and BL6 groups
requested_artifacts.acceptance: Explicitly include omitted animals; reproduce known included-cell counts and library assignments. Author scripts reference fuller local RDS objects, but that reference alone is not a deposited observation.

requested_artifacts.artifact: Sample-level timing and animal metadata for the excluded groups
required_fields: induction pulse dates or relative hours
requested_artifacts.acceptance: Confirm the actual endpoint represented by the 2Dox5 label before admitting any late withdrawal contrast. Retain publisher blanks until documented.

bounded_next_action: Search a verified public accession or supplied artifact for these exact inputs; stop before bulk raw-read acquisition if barcode assignment remains unavailable.
